# N2 Docs

> Documentation for four FiveM resources in the "Native2" pack: n2-recoil (weapon recoil control), n2-knockout (melee knockout/downed system), n2-chat (chat replacement with roleplay commands), and n2-laptop (placeable laptop item with banking, crypto, mail, marketplaces, and messaging apps). Every config key, command, and export documented is verified against the actual resource source, not inferred from naming alone.

## Scripts

- [n2-recoil](https://dustyrepo.github.io/Native2-Store-Documentations/scripts/n2-recoil.html): Client-only weapon recoil script. Per-weapon-category vertical/horizontal recoil, job-based multipliers via ESX/QBCore/QBX, aim-down-sights dampening, and free-aim camera sway. No dependencies.
- [n2-knockout](https://dustyrepo.github.io/Native2-Store-Documentations/scripts/n2-knockout.html): Melee knockout and downed system. Rolling hit-count threshold, skill-check recovery via ox_lib, impairment effects (blur, drunk walk, slowed movement), and a post-recovery headache. Auto-bridges ESX/QBCore/QBX; optional n2-chat integration.
- [n2-chat](https://dustyrepo.github.io/Native2-Store-Documentations/scripts/n2-chat.html): Standalone chat replacement. Proximity text, roleplay commands (/me, /do, /b, /ooc, /w, /s, /pm, and more), persistent world-placed scene markers, per-player languages, moderation (flood protection, word filter, Discord webhooks), and a phone-call relay. Requires oxmysql.
- [n2-laptop](https://dustyrepo.github.io/Native2-Store-Documentations/scripts/n2-laptop.html): Placeable laptop item with a full desktop UI: IonBank (real bank balance + ledger), Cryptex (fake volatile cryptocurrency), Mail (including scam templates), WishBay/HaoCang marketplaces, SellHub peer-to-peer resale with NPC negotiation, USB file storage, and Whispr private messaging. Requires ox_lib, ox_target, ox_inventory, oxmysql.

## Optional

- [Home](https://dustyrepo.github.io/Native2-Store-Documentations/): Overview and script index.
